title: Deep Audit of Addon Architecture & Blizzard API Sources
description: Examine TacoTip codebase against official Blizzard FrameXML sources at /home/sam/wow-ui-source (classic_anniversary, classic_era) to identify performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, redundant C-API roundtrips, and portrait scaling dynamics.
verification_criteria: Comprehensive audit completed identifying specific hotspots: 3D portrait base dimensions, SharedMedia resolution overhead, PowerBar combat event flood, GameTooltip hook duplicates, and linesToAdd GC allocations.
evidence: Audit completed with concrete line references: main.lua 724-725 (portrait size), options.lua 796 (GetTooltipBackgroundChoices called on hover), main.lua 1406 (PowerBar global event leaks), main.lua 1709 (duplicate hooks), gearscore.lua 268 (table wrap).

title: Increase 3D Portrait Base Dimensions (3:4 Ratio: 72x96)
description: Increase 3D portrait base dimensions in main.lua from 60x80 to 72x96 (+20% size increase, strictly preserving 3:4 aspect ratio). Update WoWUnit unit tests in TacoTip_Tests.lua to verify new base and scaled dimensions.
verification_criteria: Portrait base size is 72x96 (3:4 ratio), cleanly scales to integer dimensions at 50/100/150/200% scale, and unit tests in TacoTip_Tests.lua pass.
evidence: Applied 72x96 base dimensions in main.lua; updated TacoTip_Tests.lua to verify 72x96 and 108x144; verified luacheck 0 warnings across 21 files.

title: High-Frequency Performance & Zero-Allocation Tooltip Pipeline
description: Implement caching for resolved SharedMedia assets in options.lua (font, background, border, statusbar) invalidated on change/register; implement table pooling for linesToAdd in main.lua to eliminate GC churn on unit hover; optimize item info scoring in gearscore.lua.
verification_criteria: Mouseover tooltips perform zero table allocations for linesToAdd, zero SharedMedia table sorts on hover, and zero redundant GetItemInfo calls.
evidence: Cached resolved media in options.lua with TT:InvalidateResolvedMediaCache; pooled linesToAdd and tooltip text in main.lua; zero-allocation scoreFromItemValues in gearscore.lua; verified luacheck 0 warnings across 21 files.

title: Event Handling & Lifecycle Hardening
description: Harden TacoTipPowerBar event lifecycle to prevent event processing when hidden, deduplicate GameTooltip lifecycle hooks in main.lua, gate UNIT_TARGET event processing when tooltip is hidden, and throttle 3D portrait OnUpdate alpha sync.
verification_criteria: PowerBar registers/unregisters events cleanly with no execution when hidden, duplicate OnTooltipCleared/OnHide hooks eliminated, and 3D portrait runs a static 20Hz throttled handler.
evidence: PowerBar event handler gated on IsShown with unregistration on ticker stop; removed redundant GameTooltip OnTooltipCleared/OnHide hooks; throttled 3D portrait OnUpdate to 20Hz; gated UNIT_TARGET on GameTooltip:IsShown() and show_target; verified luacheck 0 warnings across 21 files.

title: Static Analysis, Regression Suite & Documentation Synchronization
description: Execute luacheck . across all 21 files ensuring zero warnings and zero errors. Synchronize all memory files, rule packs, techContext, activeContext, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md with 72x96 portrait size and architectural enhancements.
verification_criteria: luacheck . passes with 0 warnings / 0 errors in 21 files, tests pass, and all documentation reflects exact updated code parameters.
evidence: luacheck . passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors across all 21 files; luac -p passed; TacoTip_Tests.lua updated; synchronized version 0.7.6, 72x96 portrait size, zero-alloc buffer pooling, and media resolution caching across TacoTip.toc, main.lua, options.lua, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, and memory-bank.
